name: Cyanamide
summary: Calcium cyanamide, also known as Calcium carbondiamide, Calcium cyan-2°-amide or Calcium cyanonitride is the inorganic compound with the formula CaCN2. It is the calcium salt of the cyanamide (CN2−2) anion. This chemical is used as fertilizer and is commercially known as nitrolime. It also has herbicidal activity and in the 1950s was marketed as cyanamid.

uses.text: The main use of calcium cyanamide is in agriculture as a fertilizer.

summaryZh: 氰氨化鈣，別名石灰氮，是酸性氰胺的鈣鹽，為無色晶體或白色粉末，可溶於水並水解。

pharmacology.en: In water it releases cyanamide, which blocks aldehyde dehydrogenase, an enzyme the body uses to clear acetaldehyde. For this reason a form of it, calcium carbimide, has been used in the treatment of alcohol dependence.
pharmacology.zh: 它在水中會釋出氰胺，而氰胺會阻斷乙醛去氫酶，這是身體用來清除乙醛的酵素。因此它的一種形式「碳化二亞胺鈣」曾被用於治療酒精依賴。
pharmacology.zhHans: 它在水中会发布氰胺，而氰胺会阻断乙醛去氢酶，这是身体用来清除乙醛的酵素。因此它的一种形式「碳化二亚胺钙」曾被用于治疗酒精依赖。

sideEffects.en: It irritates the skin, eyes and airways and can cause rashes and skin ulcers. It is harmful if swallowed.
sideEffects.zh: 它會刺激皮膚、眼睛與呼吸道，可能造成皮疹與皮膚潰瘍。誤食會對身體造成傷害。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它会刺激皮肤、眼睛与呼吸道，可能造成皮疹与皮肤溃疡。误食会对身体造成伤害。

fact.en: Calcium cyanamide was the first industrial way to capture nitrogen from the air for fertiliser. The Frank-Caro process, developed in Germany around 1898, heats calcium carbide in nitrogen gas.
fact.zh: 氰氨化鈣是第一種從空氣中固定氮來製造肥料的工業方法。約在 1898 年於德國發展出的法蘭克-卡羅法，是在氮氣中加熱碳化鈣來製造它。
fact.zhHans: 氰氨化钙是第一种从空气中固定氮来制造肥料的工业方法。约在 1898 年于德国发展出的法兰克-卡罗法，是在氮气中加热碳化钙来制造它。
